structurePatterns: horizontal flex: status icon | content (title + message) | optional action + dismiss
tinted background with darker matching text/icon (the *Text role), not raw base chroma
inline variant sits within content flow; banner spans card/app width
at most one high-frequency action; dismiss only for ignorable information
usageHints: persistent contextual feedback — unlike Toast it stays until addressed or dismissed
status must be conveyed by icon shape plus text, never color alone
warning/danger do not automatically imply modal blocking
use body-small message with an optional heading-small title
doNotInvent: no solid primary-filled alert banners (tinted surface is V1)
no accent-cyan as a fifth status tone
unknowns: banner top placement safe-area handled by platform layer
